correctness.rationale: PASS: The face inequalities are |F∩A|+|F∩C|<=k and |F∩B|+|F∩C|<=k. The filtration by j=|F∩C| has associated relative chain groups, for fixed J⊂C of size j, the join of (k-j-1)-skeleta on A and B shifted by j, including augmented degree -1 conventions. Each simplex skeleton carries exactly ∧^(k-j) ker(sum) in degree k-j-1, giving the join group in degree 2(k-j)-1 and filtration total degree d_j=2k-j-1. Every spectral sequence differential lowers total homological degree and moves j to j-r, where the only target degree d_j+r is impossible, so collapse is integral for all parameters. Free extensions split as abelian groups. The sign of permutations on oriented common subset J and wedge augmentation action produce the claimed associated-graded and rational splitting. Independently enumerated mod2 homology for seven small/boundary parameter choices, including (3,3,2,3)=(1,8,1) and (4,4,3,4)=(1,27,27,1); these are corroboration rather than the universal proof.
